supporting_observations.claim: The alerted account's failed network logons recur at roughly one-minute intervals from 13:31 through 13:46 UTC, consistent with the supplied inventory description that the ClaimSync job re-authenticates every minute. Examples spanning the interval include T002-00001, T002-00009, T002-00017, T002-00020, T002-00028, and T002-00034.

The failures identify FILE-HD-01 as the workstation and show the same lsass.exe process ID, matching the inventoried host for the ClaimSync job rather than indicating an observed sequence of attempts from varied hosts. Examples: T002-00001, T002-00007, T002-00020, and T002-00034.

The supplied change calendar schedules the svc-claimsync password rotation for 13:30 UTC, and the first supplied failure is at 13:31 UTC; the recurring failures are therefore consistent with the documented rotation and a job that had not yet been manually updated. The records establish the timing and repeated failures, but do not independently confirm the rotation or configuration change.

The supplied failure records report incorrect-password status for svc-claimsync, including corresponding domain-controller authentication failures; this is consistent with stale credentials after a password rotation, rather than evidence by itself of successful access.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied records end at 13:46:09 UTC, so they do not cover the remainder of the requested 13:20–14:20 UTC window.
The supplied authentication records do not show whether the scheduled password rotation completed, when the ClaimSync job was updated, or whether later authentication succeeded.
These records do not include ClaimSync job logs, service configuration history, or process-level execution telemetry that could directly verify the source of each authentication attempt.
claims_not_established: That the scheduled password rotation actually completed at 13:30 UTC.
That the ClaimSync job was updated manually, or when any update occurred.
That no further failures or successful authentications occurred between 13:46 and 14:20 UTC.
That the repeated failures were caused by an external actor; the supplied records do not establish that.
unrelated_findings: Separate investigation: WS-LPARK-01 recorded SYSTEM using explicit credentials for svc-claimsync to PROXY-HD-01 via C:\Program Files\Commvault\ContentStore\Base\GxCVD.exe. This differs from the FILE-HD-01 recurring failure pattern; the supplied evidence does not link it to those failures. Validate the process and credential use in a separate ticket. (T002-00019)
